item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01335","case1_error":"Leading answer 40 conflicts with the correct derivation and conclusion of 50 mph.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 8 + 6 + 12 + 24 as 40 instead of 50, propagating the error into gas cost.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict; case 2 has a clear numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01336","case1_error":"Reports unsupported total 120 after calculating only Ryn's duration; the correct total is 76.","case2_error":"Defines the total as Greg plus Patrick, omitting Jacob's 18 hours.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unexplained incorrect final number; case 2 explicitly uses an incomplete total relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01337","case1_error":"Divides remaining water by loss per jump instead of allowable water loss, then unjustifiably subtracts identical jump counts.","case2_error":"Treats 12 eggs per basket as eggs per person and miscounts adults, constructing total eggs from an assumed allocation.","reason":"Case 1 confuses remaining volume with allowable loss; case 2 substitutes people for baskets and assumes the requested allocation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01338","case1_error":"Provides correct total-and-subtraction formulas but asserts unsupported final answer 19 instead of 9.","case2_error":"Leading answer 100 conflicts with the correct derivation and conclusion of 8000 flowers.","reason":"Case 2 has only an answer-marker conflict, preventing a comparison of two clear mathematical error mechanisms.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01339","case1_error":"Treats the 12-apple excess as the green-apple count, adding 16 + 12 for the total.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written expression 12 + 6 - 1 + 5 - 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"Case 1 misrepresents the quantity relationship; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
